verdict.rationale: The relay's own docs describe a track-based model ('namespaces, tracks, and objects') and subscribe-only tokens, so a separate client such as an agent can subscribe independently of the publisher. The docs never state that a subscriber can pick a single track of a live broadcast, or that the publisher needs no changes for this. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-track subscription to a live broadcast, a statement that the publisher's setup is unaffected, and hands-on corroboration of agent-side track subscription.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent subscribes to a single track of a live broadcast without the publisher changing anything about how it publishes

citations.quote: your namespaces, tracks, and objects are separated from those belonging to other relays
You control who can publish and who can subscribe by issuing tokens scoped to the operations each client needs.
one that can publish and subscribe, and one that can only subscribe
